svg.text: A. Role-Authority Mode Locking & Plan Mode Pipeline
collaboration_mode.rs + templates/plan.md — developer-tag privilege gate
Privilege Boundary: Active Mode Changes ONLY via role="developer" Tag
✗ User says "Implement this right now!" while ModeKind::Plan -> Plan the execution!
✓ Developer emits <collaboration_mode># Default...</collaboration_mode> -> Transitions
Empty-state WorldStateHash prevents repeated blank tags when custom instructions clear.
1. Discoverable Facts (U_fact)
Phase 1: Explore First, Ask Second
• Search files, types, schemas, configs
• Build/test writes to target/ allowed
• Repo-tracked file edits FORBIDDEN
Never ask "where is this struct?"
Exhaust local inspection before asking.
2. Preferences / Tradeoffs (U_pref)
Phases 2 & 3: Intent + Spec Chat
• Call request_user_input early
• 2–4 mutually exclusive options
• Include 1 recommended default
Unanswered -> record in Assumptions
Never block or repeat unanswered Qs.
Decision-Complete Output: <proposed_plan> ... </proposed_plan>
• Line-isolated English XML tags (never translated); at most 1 block per turn.
• Compact 3–5 sections: Summary, Key Changes, Test Plan, Explicit Assumptions.
• Never ask "should I proceed?"; revisions emit a full replacement spec.
B. /review Precision Rubric & Persistent Mode
prompts/templates/review/rubric.md + world_state/persistent_mode.rs
/review 8-Predicate Bug Filter & Rule Attribution
1. Diff-Introduced Only: Pre-existing defects outside the commit are dropped.
2. Proportional Rigor: Never demand validation absent from rest of repo.
3. Provable Impact: Ban speculation; cite concrete affected callers/paths.
4. Scoped Rule Attribution (AGENTS.override.md > AGENTS.md > fallbacks):
Union rule support on dedup; cite smallest line range (target <= 5–10 lines).
5. Priority Calibration: [P0] reserved strictly for input-unconditional blockers;
[P1] next cycle · [P2] normal · [P3] low + strict unfenced JSON verdict schema.
Tone: 1-paragraph matter-of-fact prose, <= 3-line code snippets, zero flattery.
Persistent Mode: Proactive Loops & RFC 7386 Tombstone Guard
• Scope Invariance: "Persistence does not broaden user-authorized scope."
• Dedup Channel: Never echo same text on send_user_message_async + final.
• Cadence: 1–3 min short waits with backoff; bound by outcome, not N polls.
Why PersistentModeSnapshot wraps Option<WorldStateHash> in a struct:
Bare None -> JSON null -> RFC 7386 Merge Patch DELETES key -> state resets to Absent!
Object {"instructions": null} survives Merge Patch so REMOVAL_NOTICE fires once.
